summary: FD_ED_TC_21_System | Session Expiration | Customer Returns | Resume or Restart
title: System | Session Expiration | Customer Returns | Resume or Restart
description:
Customer starts FD flow, gets distracted, returns 2 hours later. Tests session timeout handling and whether customer can resume or must restart. Per call transcript: session expiration and inactivity conditions need testing.

Prerequisites:
Session timeout configured (e.g., 30 minutes of inactivity); Customer starts flow, completes identification, then goes inactive
